patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Adapt.io and Ocean.io share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Adapt.io and Ocean.io share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits. Choose Adapt.io only if your buying job matches “Regional B2B contact database with credit plans — Free; Starter $49/mo; Basic $99/mo; Cust” rather than Ocean.io's shape. Choose Ocean.io only if your buying job matches “Lookalike / similar-company prospecting with credit waterfall enrichment — from ~$0.063/cr” rather than Adapt.io's shape. Workflow advantage: Adapt.io leans contact-management; Ocean.io leans lead-management. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Adapt.io and Ocean.io share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Adapt.io is Regional B2B contact database with credit plans — Free; Starter $49/mo; Basic $99/mo; Custom contact sales; 7-day trial.; Ocean.io is Lookalike / similar-company prospecting with credit waterfall enrichment — from ~$0.063/credit, ~$47/mo yearly headline..
- Company-size focus: Adapt.io (micro, small-business, mid-market) vs Ocean.io (small-business, mid-market).
- Workflow coverage skew: Adapt.io-leaning contact-management vs Ocean.io-leaning lead-management.
- Researched limits: Adapt.io — Thinner global mega-database depth than UpLead/Hunter/Apollo-class peers for many buyer niches; Ocean.io — Lookalike/similar-company specialist — not a full contact mega-database or sequencer.

Limitations — Adapt.io: Thinner global mega-database depth than UpLead/Hunter/Apollo-class peers for many buyer niches; No native email sequencing — data/export first; Ocean.io: Lookalike/similar-company specialist — not a full contact mega-database or sequencer; Credit minimums and yearly packaging require modeling before comparing to seat tools.

Poor-fit cases: Adapt.io is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Thinner global mega-database depth than UpLead/Hunter/Apollo-class peers for many buyer niches · Ocean.io is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Lookalike/similar-company specialist — not a full contact mega-database or sequencer · Avoid Adapt.io if you actually need Ocean.io's motion (Lookalike / similar-company prospecting with credit waterfall enrichment — from )

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
